title: [Master] - Slice 616928: [Expense Management] [App part] Expense Managements Travel Requisitions 💸
summary: Expense Management adds travel requisition support: new API pages for spend requests, spend request details and travelers, a Traveler table and page, and extensions of the spend request card and list. Base Application gains a Release Spend Request codeunit and a G/L link preview page, and the SpendRequestType enum is removed.
key_points: New API pages for Spend Requests, Spend Request Details and Travelers
New Traveler table and Travelers page in the Expense Agent app
Spend Request table, card and list extended by Expense Management
New Release Spend Request codeunit and Spend Req. To G/L Link Preview page in Base Application
SpendRequestType enum removed; reversal and posting preview codeunits updated across localizations
